references.text: Ibzan from Bethlehem is introduced as a judge over Israel, and this verse tells of his death and burial in the same city.
Tola died and was buried, a similar phrasing used for several judges during this period.
Jair died and was buried, following the same pattern for concluding a judge's service.
Elon died and was buried, part of the same narrative concerning the minor judges.
Abdon died and was buried, concluding the sequence of the minor judges.
Bethlehem is mentioned as Elimelech's hometown, the same city where Ibzan was buried.
Bethlehem in Judah is described as a small town with great significance, the place where Ibzan served and was buried.
